label: ajito_kakutou_020_cassiopeia_01
text: I take it you defeated the guard out front.[VAR 0x0114(0009)]

label: ajito_kakutou_020_cassiopeia_02
text: That base is run by Team Star’s Fighting crew—\nthe Caph Squad.[VAR 0x0114(0009)]

label: ajito_kakutou_020_cassiopeia_03
text: Their boss, Eri, is a skilled wrestler and coaches\nthe whole of Team Star in Pokémon battling.[VAR 0x0114(0009)]

label: ajito_kakutou_020_cassiopeia_04
text: Of all the bosses, she’ll likely be the most alert\nto hostilities after our declaration of war.[VAR 0x0114(0009)]

label: ajito_kakutou_020_cassiopeia_05
text: She might try to stop this raid in its tracks by\nchallenging you to battle before anyone else.[VAR 0x0114(0009)]

label: ajito_kakutou_020_cassiopeia_06
text: I knew it! Tell me what happened![VAR 0x0114(0009)]

label: ajito_kakutou_020_cassiopeia_07
text: She...retreated?! We’re talking about the same\nEri, right?[VAR 0x0114(0009)]

label: ajito_kakutou_020_cassiopeia_08
text: Well...it seems there’s nothing for it now but to\nattack the base head on.[VAR 0x0114(0009)]

label: ajito_kakutou_020_cassiopeia_10
text: Ring the bell on the gates once you’re ready to\nkick off this phase of the operation.\c\nTime to wipe the Caph Squad off the map![VAR 0x0114(0009)]
